title: Phase 2 — Alpha Insurance CRM: Polish, Insurance Tabs, Deploy

stories.title: Rebuild sidebar with static domain-specific navigation + brand colors
acceptanceCriteria: app-sidebar.tsx uses a static nav config (not dynamic resource names) with proper labels: Dashboard, Clients, Carriers, Pipeline, Follow-Ups, Activity Log, SMS Campaigns, Reply Analyzer, Call Scripts, Stop List, Import Data, Settings
Sidebar background is #170810 (dark warm), text is #E8D5C4 cream
Active item background is #7B1C2A burgundy with white text
Hover shows rgba(123,28,42,0.3) tint
Two nav sections separated by a divider: main CRM nav and tools nav
Each nav item has a proper Lucide icon (LayoutDashboard, Users, Building2, TrendingUp, CheckSquare, Activity, MessageSquare, MessageCircle, Phone, Ban, Upload)
Footer shows signed-in user name and initials avatar
Sidebar collapsible to icon-only at 64px wide

stories.title: Build Import Data tab (/import) with CSV parsing, dedup, status normalization
acceptanceCriteria: File src/components/alpha-crm/import-data/ImportData.tsx exists
Textarea accepts CSV or tab-separated text
Format selector: CSV, Tab-separated with auto-detect toggle
Preview table renders parsed rows with column headers
Status normalization applied: ACTIVE EFT -> ACTIVE, PENDING CANCEL -> AT_RISK, EXPIRED -> LAPSED, TERMINATED -> CANCELLED etc
Phone formatting: strip non-digits, prepend +1 if 10 digits
Import button upserts to Supabase clients table via useCreate/dataProvider
Success message shows count: 'Imported X clients. Y duplicates merged. Z rows skipped'
Deduplication: match on policy_number first, then phone, then skip
Empty state has helpful instructions

stories.title: Build SMS Campaigns tab (/sms) with segment selector, message composer, stop list filter
acceptanceCriteria: File src/components/alpha-crm/sms-campaigns/SmsCampaigns.tsx exists
Segment selector: Active, At Risk, Lapsed, Cancelled tabs with client count badge
Message composer textarea with character count and merge field insert buttons: {first_name}, {carrier}, {agent_name}
Preview panel shows 3 sample messages with merge fields resolved
Stop list filter: queries stop_list table and shows exclusion count
Queue Campaign button writes to sms_queue Supabase table
Campaign history table shows past campaigns
UI clearly states: 'Messages will be queued, not sent immediately'
No API keys or sending logic in this component

stories.title: Build Reply Analyzer tab (/replies) with Anthropic API classification
acceptanceCriteria: File src/components/alpha-crm/reply-analyzer/ReplyAnalyzer.tsx exists
Textarea for reply text and phone number field
Analyze button calls Anthropic API at VITE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var
Classification displayed: OPT_OUT, NOT_INTERESTED, HOT_LEAD, INTERESTED, PAYMENT_INTENT, CALLBACK_REQUEST, GENERAL
Confidence level shown: High / Medium / Low
PAYMENT_INTENT classification ALWAYS shows 'Route to Amanda' as primary action button (non-negotiable requirement)
OPT_OUT shows 'Add to Stop List' action
CALLBACK_REQUEST/INTERESTED shows 'Create Follow-Up' action
'Log Interaction' button writes to contact_logs table
Phone number lookup matches against clients in Supabase and shows client info card
API key from VITE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var only, never hardcoded

stories.title: Build Call Script Engine tab (/scripts) with client selector and Anthropic generation
acceptanceCriteria: File src/components/alpha-crm/call-scripts/CallScripts.tsx exists
Client search/select that queries Supabase clients by name or phone
Selected client info card: name, carrier, product, status, premium, last contact, days since last contact
Script type selector: Phone Call, Text Message, Email
Optional context textarea
Generate Script button calls Anthropic API with personalized system prompt using client data
Script output panel shows generated script in clean readable format
Copy to Clipboard button
Log as Interaction button writes to contact_logs
Payment-related context always yields: 'Please call Amanda directly at the office for billing questions'
API key from VITE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY only

stories.title: Build Stop List tab (/stop-list) with add/remove/search/bulk import
acceptanceCriteria: File src/components/alpha-crm/stop-list/StopList.tsx exists
Search bar filters by phone number
Add phone input with reason dropdown: Opted Out, Do Not Contact, Wrong Number, Deceased, Other
Table shows: phone, reason, added_by, created_at with Remove button
Remove button has confirmation modal
Bulk import: paste phones one per line and add all
Stats bar shows total count and last updated date
Reads/writes to Supabase stop_list table

stories.title: Wire all new routes in CRM.tsx and add Supabase migration for sms_queue + stop_list
acceptanceCriteria: CRM.tsx has CustomRoutes for /import, /sms, /replies, /scripts, /stop-list
All 5 new tab components are imported in CRM.tsx
Supabase migration file exists at supabase/migrations/20260614000000_sms_queue_stop_list.sql
Migration creates sms_queue table with: id, segment, message_template, client_count, excluded_count, queued_at, status, queued_by
Migration creates stop_list table with: id, phone, reason, added_by, created_at
Both tables have RLS policies for authenticated users
No references to 'Contacts', 'Companies', or 'Deals' remain in user-facing UI text

stories.title: Brand colors applied globally + netlify.toml + .env.example updated
acceptanceCriteria: netlify.toml exists with build command 'npm run build', publish 'dist', and SPA redirect rule
.env.example includes VITE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY entry with documentation comment
Primary button color uses burgundy #7B1C2A via CSS custom property or Tailwind class override
Main content background is warm off-white (#FAFAF9)
Browser tab title in index.html says 'Alpha Insurance CRM'
ready.tsx no longer shows marmelab links (updated to Alpha Insurance branding)
